title: Aimz CSGO Crosshair
description: A PVP and Combat crosshair based on CSGO
body:
# Aimz - CSGO Crosshair Summary Custom crosshair made for use on my [DarkRPG](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/darkrpg) modpack. Now released as a standalone.   Description This will further improve your vanilla experience by changing the standard vanilla crosshair into a pvp  and combat design crosshair based on the popular CSGO game, great for using in a pvp environment but even works in singleplayer or regular servers. Looking for more crosshairs, fonts or resource packs? check out my other projects [Here](https://www.curseforge.com/members/gamerpotion/projects)  (gun not included) ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/977/117/2024-09-28_02.png)   Get a server today and play with your friends!
